title: Velista: the compact view and the reel
lede: Plans 0202, 0203 and 0204. The row of 0191 with the button stepper becomes the default view; the compact view is the two line row with the reel of 0043 restored, stepping by today's rule. A picker in the header of the zone list and of the basket chooses between them. Every frame is drawn Day in Spanish and Night in English, at 390 by 844, from the source on dev at e06813139 and the reel as it was deleted at d8daa824c^. The lines and prices are sample data. Photos are the Open Food Facts copies from ../typeahead/photos, CC BY-SA 3.0. Generated from the committed *.dc.html artboards and the notes in canvas.json. Round 3 (after the owner's review): icon set B everywhere; the basket's picker in the tools row and in the basket's menu; every reel one fixed size so the reels line up; Due rows say only "Add"; and a new board, ReelUnit, with the unit drawn under the number.

annotations.text:
WHICH PLAN EACH FRAME ANSWERS.
Picker, Icons and Basket: velista 0202, section 1, frames 1 and 2.
Default and Compact: 0202 frame 3, and 0203 frames 1 and 5. The two boards draw the same ten lines, so the rows can be counted side by side.
Reel open: 0203 frame 2 and spec 2.
Due rows: 0203 frame 3. Product page: 0203 frame 4.
Row sheet: 0204, the one frame it asks for, under the rewritten 0200 and 0201.
Every zone list frame draws the header of velista 0205: the list's name, and under it "in Casa" / "en Casa" in the small muted size, both inside the 64 px block. The head block above the search field has no group line.

MEASURED ON THESE FRAMES.
The control: the stepper is 155 by 48. The reel has one fixed size in every frame (round 3): 72 by 40 with the unit beside the number, 52 by 44 with the unit under it (board ReelUnit, B).
Room for words at 390: in the compact row the name and its price share 218 px with the 72 px reel and 238 px with the 52 px one; the same two line row with the stepper left them 135 px.
Rows: the default row is 99 px, the compact row 68 px. Between the search field and the bar there are 629 px, now that the group line sits in the header (velista 0205): six rows and a third of the seventh in the default view, nine and a quarter in the compact one. About 45 percent more rows on a screen.

ROUND 3: DECIDED, AND STILL OPEN.
Decided by the owner: icon set B; the basket's picker in the tools row and in the basket's menu (the fourth header action is dropped); one size for every reel; Due rows say only "Add".
Still open:
1. Which header button "the icon in the header is fine" meant: 1 (A's two rows, drawn before) or 2 (B's, drawn now). Board Icons.
2. The unit under the number: A, B or C on board ReelUnit. B is recommended. Until then the other frames keep the unit beside the number in a 72 px reel.
3. The words. Proposed: "Normal" for Default in Spanish, and Compact drawn as a name with "More rows on the screen" under it rather than one line with a colon, because one line wraps at 276 px.

NO SCREENSHOTS OF TODAY.
The staging test account in tmp/velista-user-staging no longer signs in: staging refused it on 2026-11-22 with "that email and password do not match". The production copy onto staging of 2026-11-19 probably replaced it. So every frame is drawn from source, and the default view board stands in for today's row.

THE PICKER.
The first header action on the zone list, before the filter, as plan 0202 asks (beside the filter). Its name is "View" / "Vista". The popover is the choice frame of AnchoredPopover: 276 px, rows to its edges, the raised surface, the hairline and the second elevation. The current row carries the tick in the quiet amber and the heavier weight; that is the only accent.

THE TAPE RUNS SIDEWAYS.
As the reel of 0043 did: previous, current and next in a row, 56 px tall, growing left from the reel. It covers its own row's name and price; on a 68 px row it stays inside the row and only its shadow reaches the rows above and below. Plan 0203 frame 2 says "over the next row"; this is that overlay as it was built. A tape that runs down over the next row would be a new gesture, not a restore.
A weight writes its words on the tape: 975 g, 1 kg, 1,05 kg. The spec's 925, 950, 975, 1000, 1050 are the same steps in grams.

TWO CHANGES TO THE OLD PILL.
The restored pill had a minimum width of 52 and grew with its words, so "1,5 kg" made a wider reel than "6" and the column broke. Round 3 fixes the width: 72 with the unit beside the number, 52 with it under the number. The pill keeps 4 px of padding on each side. Everything else is the old stylesheet: the subtle border, 12 px radius, the zero style with no fill.

A PROBLEM: ONE LINE DOES NOT FIT 52 PX.
Measured at today's 16 px semibold: "950 g" is 40.7 px of text, "1,5 kg" 43.8, "12,5 kg" 52.7, and the widest value the app can print, "99,95 kg" (any weight from 99 945 g), 61.5. With the 1 px border and 4 px of padding a side, a fixed reel needs 54 px for "1,5 kg", 63 for "12,5 kg" and 72 for "99,95 kg".
So the one line frames draw every reel at 72 by 40, the smallest fixed width that fits every value. It costs the name 20 px against a 52 px reel.
The stacked layout on board ReelUnit solves it: the widest figure, "99,95", is 38.6 px at 15 px bold, so every value fits 52 px.
A count never needs more: its ceiling 99 999 prints as "100 K" ("100 k" in English), 40.8 px on one line.

PLEASE CONFIRM WITH ONE WORD.
If "the icon in the header is fine" meant the header button drawn before this round (1: A's two rows) rather than B's button (2), say so. Every frame now draws 2, B's button, because set B was chosen. Answer "1" or "2".

THE UNIT UNDER THE NUMBER: B IS RECOMMENDED.
A, 52 by 40: no growth, but the unit drops to 10 px, below the 11 px floor every other text in the app keeps.
B, 52 by 44: 4 px more, inside the 44 px tap box the reel already had. Number 15 px (a bit smaller than today's 16), unit 11 px, the size of the "/ kg" beside the price. It reads at a glance on Day and Night.
C, 52 by 48: keeps today's 16 px number, but the pill stands 4 px taller than the 44 px picture beside it and the row looks heavier.
In all three the compact row stays 68 px tall: its content is 60 px, the tallest reel 48.
The widest stacked figure, "99,95", is 38.6 px at 15 px and 41.2 at 16; the pill's inside is 46 px, so 52 holds every value.

THE ROW SHEET (0204).
The colours of 0201 move onto the reel: the resting number and every number on the tape are green when equal to the list's ask and amber above it. Both pass the contrast floor on the raised surface and on the tape: green 5.5 to 1 and amber 4.9 to 1 on Day, both above 8 to 1 on Night.
The label is "<list> · <ask>", the list name cut first and the ask never. No menu trigger on a row: plan 0200 dropped it. The lists' heading reads "What you bought" / "Lo que has comprado" (0201), with the text button "Lists and amounts" / "Listas y cantidades" on its right, which opens the detailed view (0200). "Bought for another list" draws reels too, from 0.
